Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DM&HO Mahabubnagar Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates must report on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Medical Officer post is an MBBS degree with a valid T.G Council Registration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer position will receive a salary of Rs. 52,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Medical Officer post is between 18 years and 44 years, with applicable age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Officer post in the District Medical and Health Office Mahabubnagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves evaluation based on Qualifying Examination Marks and an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the District Medical and Health Office Mahabubnagar. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.
